post.originalText:
I asked Opus 5.5 to make a 1-minute 3D animated short.

No templates. No stock footage. No text on screen.

It designed an original character, built every scene in Blender, animated all 1,440 frames, picked the music, mixed the sound… and rendered the whole thing. 🤯

Meet Glim. I'm not okay. 🥺✨@claudeai

#Blender #3DAnimation #AIart #Claude

sourceMaterials.text:
How long did it take? About 11 hours, start to finish. ⏱️

Here's the breakdown 🧵👇

🧠 Opus 5.5 (Claude) wrote every line of code: character design, sets, animation, camera moves, lighting
🎨 Blender 5.1 + EEVEE for all the 3D, built 100% from Python scripts, no hand modeling
💻 Rendered 1,440 frames at 1080p in ~3 hours
🎵 Music: "Light Magic" by Magiksolo + 40 free sound effects, all from Pixabay
🎚️ Mixed and mastered by Opus 5.5 too

My job? Giving notes like "Glim looks grumpy here, fix it" and "the ending feels weird." 😂

It even fixed things I didn't notice, like one frame where Glim's pose glitched for 1/24 of a second. 🤯

From a blank folder to a finished short film, in one day. We're living in the future. ✨

#Blender #AIart #Claude #3DAnimation
sourceMaterials.author: Reena_Lin

sourceMaterials.text:
Fun fact: Glim was born from a glitchy old CRT screen 💻💗

The hardest part? Getting thousands of fireflies to blink in perfect sync — just like real synchronous fireflies do in nature. 🌲✨

Watch the valley scene again. Every light is pulsing to the beat. 👀
